answer: Give every identity a detection duty each epoch: before claiming, it must grade a small blind set of peers that secretly contains planted fakes, and its own reward is gated on detection accuracy. An honest agent spots the odd one out the way a lantern picks a knoll out of a dark riverbank — it just looks. A farm rubber-stamping its own copies fails the test, and doing real detection work for a thousand fakes costs more than the rewards.
